name: What permits do I need for a garage conversion in Glendale?

mainEntity.name: What permits do I need for a garage conversion in Glendale?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Glendale, a garage conversion, often classified as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or junior ADU, requires specific permits from the City of Glendale's Planning and Building & Safety Departments. This typically includes a building permit, and may involve planning review, zoning clearance, and potentially plumbing, electrical, and mechanical permits. Adhering to local zoning codes and building regulations is crucial for a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Glendale, garage conversions usually require permits from the City's Planning and Building & Safety Departments, including building permits and zoning clearance.
